title: Single-source social disagreement to hourly variance
claim: A linear social-disagreement increment improves next-hour variance forecasts over registered market controls.
mechanism: Greater disagreement creates heterogeneous trading and higher subsequent variance.

evidence.summary: The candidate was worse than its control with Holm-adjusted p=1.0.

nextAction: Keep this linear single-source version rejected; a new disagreement mechanism requires fresh data and a separately bounded search.
